selected.decisionBasis: The targeted retry removes the fatal looped rack and shows one straight threaded shank passing through one knurled nut, one wrench safely enclosing one clearly cylindrical fitting, no person or unsafe force multiplier, and strong 320-pixel recognition. It is not a final production pass because the fixed heel jaw's tangent contact is partly hidden by the body at 320 pixels and the handle recess/hang-hole treatment remains too close to anatomy-reference product conventions for an unqualified originality decision.

attempts.finding: The round-fitting scene, monochrome treatment, and safe no-person context are clear, but the adjusting nut engages a separate curved U-shaped looped rack instead of one straight shank continuous with the movable hook jaw. This visible contradictory mechanism is fatal.

The straight single-shank correction succeeds and the working grip reads clearly. The lower fixed-jaw contact is partly occluded at phone size, while the handle recess and hanging-hole convention require an additional rights/similarity judgment before master promotion.
